tracked_history_facts_used: previous round winner only for POST_PISTOL; reconstructed from the immediately preceding audit round to model continuous normal-player GSI

comparison_contract.strategic_mode_label: POST_PISTOL pistol winners use rounds.json team*Economy=full; all individual purchase fields remain player-economies labels

comparison_contract.actual_spend: strict individual player moneySpent; drop-sensitive regulation rows excluded
